intro: Intro of Settings › Chat skills. A skill is a saved instruction people trigger by typing its name after a slash, such as /grill-me; keep the slash names as they are (code). Telegram is a product name. Socio means the AI agent.
mode.turn: How long a skill's instructions apply: only to the message that starts with it.
mode.until-done: How long a skill's instructions apply: every message until the person says they are done (/done).
when: A date and time in a skill's history.
lock.digest: A content fingerprint (code). Keep "sha256" as it is; {{hash}} is hexadecimal.
lock.adapted: Where a skill came from. {{source}} is a repository path, maybe with "@ <commit>" (code); the license variant adds its license name, such as MIT.
lock.edited: Part of a skill's source line: the workspace edited it after importing.
lock.builtIn: Part of a skill's source line: it ships with Socio.
lock.revision: Part of a skill's source line: its revision number.
history.label: Accessible name of a skill's revision list. {{name}} is the skill's name (after the slash).
history.revision: Heading of one entry in a skill's history list; {{revision}} is its revision number.
history.line: One revision: {{when}} its date, {{who}} who saved it, {{mode}} one of mode.*, {{hash}} a short fingerprint (code). The restored variant says which revision it put back.
history.current: Marks the revision in use now, instead of a Roll back button.
history.rollBack: Button: makes this revision the current one again.
history.rolledBack: Toast after a rollback. {{name}} is the skill's name.
list.workspace: After a skill's name in the list: the workspace made it (not built in). The untilDone variant also says it applies until the person is done.
list.builtIn: After a skill's name in the list: it ships with Socio. The untilDone variant also says it applies until the person is done.
list.history: Button on a skill in the list: shows or hides its past revisions.
list.edit: Button on a skill in the list: opens the form to change it.
list.remove: Button on a skill in the list: removes the skill (after a confirmation).
list.add: Button below the list of skills: opens the form for a new skill.
form.edit: Accessible name of the form editing a skill. {{name}} is its name.
form.new: Accessible name of the form that creates a new skill.
form.name: Label of the field for the skill's name, typed after a slash (/).
form.nameLabel: Accessible name of the skill name field (read by screen readers).
form.namePlaceholder: Example skill name in the name field; one lowercase word or hyphenated words, no spaces.
form.description: Label of the field for the skill's short description, shown in the / menu of the message box.
form.descriptionLabel: Accessible name of the skill description field (read by screen readers).
form.descriptionPlaceholder: "The / menu" is the list that opens when someone types a slash in the message box.
form.instructions: Label of the field for the skill's instructions to the socio (AI agent).
form.instructionsLabel: Accessible name of the skill instructions field (read by screen readers).
form.mode: Label of the select choosing how long the skill's instructions apply (one message, or until the person is done).
form.modeLabel: Accessible name of the select of how long a skill applies (read by screen readers).
form.modeHelp: "The composer" is the message box at the bottom of a chat; /done is a command, keep it as is.
form.save: Button that saves the skill form.
form.cancel: Button that closes the skill form without saving.
form.takenName: Error under the name field: another skill has that name.
saved: Toast after saving a skill. {{name}} is its name.
confirmRemove: Confirmation before removing a skill. {{name}} is its name.
import.title: Title of the expandable section that imports a skill from a public GitHub repository. GitHub is a product name.
import.intro: SKILL.md is a file name; keep it as is. GitHub is a product name.
import.url: Label of the field for the address of the GitHub repository to import from.
import.urlLabel: Accessible name of the repository address field (read by screen readers).
import.ref: Label: the git branch, tag or commit to import from.
import.refLabel: Accessible name of the branch, tag or commit field (read by screen readers). "Ref" is a git term.
import.path: Label: where the SKILL.md file is in the repository. Keep SKILL.md as is.
import.pathLabel: Accessible name of the SKILL.md path field (read by screen readers).
import.working: Button text while a preview or install runs.
import.preview: Button: fetches the skill from the repository and shows it for review before installing.
import.installed: Status after installing an imported skill. {{name}} is its name, {{commit}} a short git commit id (code). The update variant is for a skill that existed already.
import.previewLabel: Accessible name of the panel showing the fetched skill for review (read by screen readers).
import.source: {{ref}} is a git branch, tag or commit; {{commit}} the full commit id (code).
import.license: {{license}} is a license name, such as MIT.
import.attribution: Expandable section with the imported skill's license text and credits.
import.changes: Collapsible section: the difference from the skill's current revision {{revision}}.
import.changesLabel: Accessible name of the box showing what changed in the instructions (read by screen readers).
import.noChanges: Stands in for the difference when the instructions are the same.
import.current: Collapsible section: the skill's current revision {{revision}}, to compare.
import.currentLabel: Accessible name of the box showing the skill's current instructions (read by screen readers).
import.complete: Collapsible section: the full imported instructions; {{count}} is their length in characters.
import.completeLabel: Accessible name of the box showing the full imported instructions (read by screen readers).
import.applyUpdate: Button: installs the previewed version over the existing skill.
